name: Bizzmags Sync for Trendyol and WC
author: Claudiu Maftei

sections.description:
Get Pro version: https://bizzmags.ro/integrare-trendyol-si-woocommerce/

Sync for Trendyol and WooCommerce allows you to integrate your WooCommerce store with the Trendyol Marketplace and manage everything from a single place.

Automate product uploads, stock updates, price synchronization, and order management to save time and reduce manual work.

Compatible with Trendyol marketplaces in: DE, SA, AE, GR, SK, RO, CZ and BG.

Why use this plugin?

Managing products and orders across WooCommerce and Trendyol manually can be time-consuming and error-prone.

This plugin helps you:
– Sync products between WooCommerce and Trendyol
– Keep stock and prices updated automatically
– Manage marketplace orders directly from WooCommerce
– Reduce manual work and avoid overselling

Features

Product Sync

  • Send products to Trendyol marketplace
  • Apply price percentage adjustments

Category & Attribute Mapping

  • Import marketplace categories
  • Map Trendyol categories to WooCommerce categories
  • Import and map attributes and attribute values
  • Import accepted brands

Automation

  • Background processing for category imports
  • Category-specific image size handling
  • Support for custom product metadata (EAN, brand)

Pro Features

The Pro version extends the plugin with advanced automation and marketplace management tools:

  • All free features included
  • Import products from Trendyol into WooCommerce
  • Create WooCommerce products from marketplace listings
  • Create marketplace orders into WooCommerce
  • Cancel marketplace orders and update stock
  • Real-time price updates and Buy Box monitoring
  • Advanced stock rules (based on SKU, price, weight, etc.)
  • Prevent overwriting custom product data during updates
  • Detailed logging and diagnostics

Requirements

  • WooCommerce installed and active
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Valid Trendyol Marketplace seller account
  • Trendyol API credentials (Seller ID, API Key, API Secret)

External Services

This plugin connects to the Trendyol Marketplace API.

Service: Trendyol API
Purpose: Synchronize products, stock, and orders
Data sent: Product data, stock levels, order information
Terms: https://partner.trendyol.com/
Privacy Policy: https://tymp.mncdn.com/prod/documents/engagement/yasal_surecler/kisisel_verilerin_korunmasi_hakkinda_aydinlatma_metni.pdf
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Go to the plugin settings page
  4. Enter your Trendyol API credentials (Seller ID, API Key, API Secret, Endpoint)
  5. Configure category and attribute mappings
  6. Start syncing products and orders
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Trendyol Marketplace?

Yes, it supports Trendyol marketplaces in DE, SA, AE, GR, SK, RO, CZ and BG.

Can I send products to Trendyol?

Yes, you can create and update products on the marketplace.

Can I import products from Trendyol?

Yes, this feature is available in the Pro version.

Can I sync orders?

Yes, order synchronization is available in the Pro version.

What happens if product IDs differ?

If product IDs differ between WooCommerce and Trendyol, conflicts may occur. The Pro version includes tools to handle these cases.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function.

Does it support WordPress Multisite?

Yes, it is compatible with WordPress Multisite.
